evidence.title: GitHub - AmitMirgal/orgbot-hub: 🤖 orgbots is a directory of Grok Bot teams you can install. · GitHub

name: orgbots
summary: Public directory of Grok Bot teams (packs), with a chat that finds existing bots for the jobs you describe.
description: orgbots.dev is a public directory of Grok Bot teams other people already made, and this repo is its source. Instead of searching by pack name, you describe the jobs you need and a chat suggests bots that already exist in the catalog; each pick opens the author's official x.ai/bot template, which you add one at a time in the Grok app. Packs are one author's published team; browsing Team needs no sign-in, while sending a mix needs GitHub, X or email under a daily message limit.
contains: public directory of Grok Bot teams ('packs') published by other people
a chat matches the jobs you describe to bots that already exist; it does not invent bots
each pick opens the author's official x.ai/bot template; bots are added one at a time in the Grok app
packs: a desk handles random questions, a seat has one repeating job
browsing Team needs no sign-in; sending a mix needs GitHub, X or email; daily message limit
public source: Next.js app on port 43147 with Prisma CRUD, Supabase Auth, Mastra memory and PostHog analytics
agent skills and editor configs included (.agents/skills, .claude/skills, .cursor, skills-lock.json)
Submit for new packs is coming soon; only official x.ai/bot URLs accepted
